jp: さまざまな品種改良の末に生まれた名馬中の名馬。抜きん出たその品質から、その名がエリートを指す代名詞として使われることも多い。
jp_grezzo: "さまざまな品種改良の末に生まれた名馬中の名馬。抜きん出たその品質から、その名がエリートを指す代名詞として使われることも多い。"
en: The best of the best horses, born after various breedings. Because of their outstanding quality, their name is often used as a synonym for the elite.
en_grezzo: "The best of the best horses, born after various breedings. Because of their outstanding quality, their name is often used as a synonym for the elite."
it: Il cavallo di razza fra i cavalli di razza, nato in fondo a un lungo lavoro di selezione. La qualità che ha è tanto fuori dal comune che spesso il suo nome si usa per dire il fior fiore di qualunque cosa.

jp: 古代にいくつもの生き物の遺伝子を混ぜて作られた奇妙な生物。活性化し続ける細胞が成長とともに肉体を変形させる。
jp_grezzo: "古代にいくつもの生き物の遺伝子を混ぜて作られた奇妙な生物。活性化し続ける細胞が成長とともに肉体を変形させる。"
en: A strange creature created in ancient times by mixing the genes of several creatures. Its continuously active cells transform its body as it grows.
en_grezzo: "A strange creature created in ancient times by mixing the genes of several creatures. Its continuously active cells transform its body as it grows."
it: Una creatura strana, fabbricata nell'antichità mescolando i geni di parecchi esseri viventi. Le cellule restano sempre attive e, mentre cresce, gli deformano il corpo.

jp: ご近所でも評判の変人。しかしその頭脳は疑う余地なく天才的であり、生化学専門でありながら前文明の遺産である遺伝子の複合装置を再現し量産するに至った。
jp_grezzo: "ご近所でも評判の変人。しかしその頭脳は疑う余地なく天才的であり、生化学専門でありながら前文明の遺産である遺伝子の複合装置を再現し量産するに至った。"
en: He is a reputed weirdo in the neighbourhood. But his brain is unquestionably genius, and although he specialises in biochemistry, he has managed to recreate and mass produce a genetic complex device that is a legacy of previous civilisations.
en_grezzo: "He is a reputed weirdo in the neighbourhood. But his brain is unquestionably genius, and although he specialises in biochemistry, he has managed to recreate and mass produce a genetic complex device that is a legacy of previous civilisations."
it: Nel vicinato ha fama di essere un tipo strano. Ma la sua testa è geniale, e non c'è da discutere: pur essendo specialista di biochimica è arrivato a riprodurre, e a produrre in serie, l'apparecchio che combina i geni, lascito della civiltà di prima.

jp: ルミエストの美観を保つ事に腐心する掃除屋。掃除屋という肩書を殺し屋のことと勘違いされることがあり困っている。彼に言わせれば、ゴミをポイ捨てする者はそのゴミ以下の存在価値であるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "ルミエストの美観を保つ事に腐心する掃除屋。掃除屋という肩書を殺し屋のことと勘違いされることがあり困っている。彼に言わせれば、ゴミをポイ捨てする者はそのゴミ以下の存在価値であるらしい。"
en: A cleaner who is obsessed with keeping Lumiest looking beautiful. He is troubled by the fact that his title of cleaner is sometimes mistaken for that of an assassin. In his opinion, those who litter are worth less than the rubbish they litter.
en_grezzo: "A cleaner who is obsessed with keeping Lumiest looking beautiful. He is troubled by the fact that his title of cleaner is sometimes mistaken for that of an assassin. In his opinion, those who litter are worth less than the rubbish they litter."
it: Un netturbino che si consuma per tenere bello l'aspetto di Lumiest. Gli dispiace che il suo mestiere, il ripulitore, qualcuno lo scambi per quello del sicario. A sentir lui, chi butta i rifiuti per terra vale meno dei rifiuti che butta.

jp: 魔術士ギルドを治めている若き実力者。日々魔道書の解読に勤しむ。最近魔法書店を他ギルド民に勝手に利用されている事が判明し、悩んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "魔術士ギルドを治めている若き実力者。日々魔道書の解読に勤しむ。最近魔法書店を他ギルド民に勝手に利用されている事が判明し、悩んでいる。"
en: A young and powerful man who governs the Mages' Guild. He spends his days deciphering grimoires. He is troubled by the recent discovery that the magic bookshop is being used by other guild members without his permission.
en_grezzo: "A young and powerful man who governs the Mages' Guild. He spends his days deciphering grimoires. He is troubled by the recent discovery that the magic bookshop is being used by other guild members without his permission."
it: Un giovane di valore, che governa la Gilda dei Maghi. Passa le giornate a decifrare i libri di magia. Di recente ha scoperto che la libreria magica se la usano senza permesso anche quelli delle altre gilde, e la cosa lo tormenta.

jp: 魔術士ギルドの門番と、加入者に課題を与える仕事をしている。自分の装備が呪われていないにも関わらずテレポートしている事があり、疑問に感じている。
jp_grezzo: "魔術士ギルドの門番と、加入者に課題を与える仕事をしている。自分の装備が呪われていないにも関わらずテレポートしている事があり、疑問に感じている。"
en: He works as a gatekeeper for the Mages' Guild and gives assignments to subscribers. He is sometimes teleported despite the fact that his equipment is not cursed and is questioned.
en_grezzo: "He works as a gatekeeper for the Mages' Guild and gives assignments to subscribers. He is sometimes teleported despite the fact that his equipment is not cursed and is questioned."
it: Fa il guardiano della porta della Gilda dei Maghi e assegna le prove a chi si iscrive. Ogni tanto si ritrova teletrasportato pur non avendo addosso niente di maledetto, e la cosa lo lascia perplesso.

jp: 犯罪者の町ダルフィにおいてなお、一番の暗部である盗賊ギルドを束ねる長。裏切り、裏切られを繰り返すうち彼の心は闇に閉ざされ、人を信用できなくなってしまった。
jp_grezzo: "犯罪者の町ダルフィにおいてなお、一番の暗部である盗賊ギルドを束ねる長。裏切り、裏切られを繰り返すうち彼の心は闇に閉ざされ、人を信用できなくなってしまった。"
en: He is the head of the Thieves' Guild, which is still the darkest part of the criminal town of Derphy. His heart has been betrayed and betrayed again and again, and his mind has become closed to the darkness and he no longer trusts people.
en_grezzo: "He is the head of the Thieves' Guild, which is still the darkest part of the criminal town of Derphy. His heart has been betrayed and betrayed again and again, and his mind has become closed to the darkness and he no longer trusts people."
it: Il capo che tiene insieme la Gilda dei Ladri, che perfino a Derphy, città di criminali, resta il posto più oscuro. A furia di tradire ed essere tradito il suo cuore si è chiuso nel buio, e non riesce più a fidarsi di nessuno.

jp: ダルフィの酒場にある、地下へと続く階段を守っている盗賊ギルドの番人。常に警戒を怠ってはいないつもりなのだが、いつの間にか違う場所にいることがよくある。
jp_grezzo: "ダルフィの酒場にある、地下へと続く階段を守っている盗賊ギルドの番人。常に警戒を怠ってはいないつもりなのだが、いつの間にか違う場所にいることがよくある。"
en: Keeper of the Thieves' Guild, who guards the staircase leading to the basement in Derphy's tavern. He intends to be on constant alert, but is often in the wrong place at the wrong time.
en_grezzo: "Keeper of the Thieves' Guild, who guards the staircase leading to the basement in Derphy's tavern. He intends to be on constant alert, but is often in the wrong place at the wrong time."
it: Il guardiano della Gilda dei Ladri, che sorveglia la scala che dalla taverna di Derphy scende nel sotterraneo. Nelle sue intenzioni non abbassa mai la guardia, ma capita spesso che, senza accorgersene, si ritrovi da tutt'altra parte.

jp: 戦士ギルドの長を務めている美剣士。彼女目当てでギルドに加入する者は少なくないが、本人は剣を振り回すこと以外に興味がないためそのことに気付いていない。
jp_grezzo: "戦士ギルドの長を務めている美剣士。彼女目当てでギルドに加入する者は少なくないが、本人は剣を振り回すこと以外に興味がないためそのことに気付いていない。"
en: A beautiful swordsman who is the head of the Warrior Guild. Many people join the guild for her, but she is unaware of this as she has no interest in anything other than wielding a sword.
en_grezzo: "A beautiful swordsman who is the head of the Warrior Guild. Many people join the guild for her, but she is unaware of this as she has no interest in anything other than wielding a sword."
it: Una bella spadaccina, che fa da capo alla Gilda dei Guerrieri. Non sono pochi quelli che si iscrivono alla gilda per lei, ma a parte menare la spada niente le interessa, e quindi non se n'è accorta.

jp: 戦士ギルドの門番と、加入者に課題を与える仕事をしている。知らないうちにテレポートしている事態が頻発し、そのたびに定位置に戻るのが最近辛くなってきた。
jp_grezzo: "戦士ギルドの門番と、加入者に課題を与える仕事をしている。知らないうちにテレポートしている事態が頻発し、そのたびに定位置に戻るのが最近辛くなってきた。"
en: He works as a gatekeeper for the Warrior Guild and gives assignments to subscribers. Frequent teleportation situations occur without his knowledge, and it has recently become difficult for him to return to his position each time.
en_grezzo: "He works as a gatekeeper for the Warrior Guild and gives assignments to subscribers. Frequent teleportation situations occur without his knowledge, and it has recently become difficult for him to return to his position each time."
it: Fa il guardiano della porta della Gilda dei Guerrieri e assegna le prove a chi si iscrive. Gli capita di continuo di ritrovarsi teletrasportato senza saperlo, e ultimamente tornare ogni volta al proprio posto ha cominciato a pesargli.

jp: 魔を討つために、魔を移植された、非常に優れた身体能力を得た戦士。所持している武器からクレイモアと呼ばれる事もある。
jp_grezzo: "魔を討つために、魔を移植された、非常に優れた身体能力を得た戦士。所持している武器からクレイモアと呼ばれる事もある。"
en: Warriors who have been implanted with demons in order to defeat them, and who have acquired very good physical abilities. She is sometimes called Claymore because of the weapon she carries.
en_grezzo: "Warriors who have been implanted with demons in order to defeat them, and who have acquired very good physical abilities. She is sometimes called Claymore because of the weapon she carries."
it: Una guerriera a cui, per battere il demoniaco, hanno innestato addosso il demoniaco, e che ne ha ricavato doti fisiche fuori dal comune. Dall'arma che porta le viene anche il soprannome di Claymore.

jp: 力を求める人に追われる存在であるリトルシスターを、その身を盾として守りながらネフィアに隠れ住む。彼の小さな天使を脅かすものに対しては一切容赦しない。
jp_grezzo: "力を求める人に追われる存在であるリトルシスターを、その身を盾として守りながらネフィアに隠れ住む。彼の小さな天使を脅かすものに対しては一切容赦しない。"
en: He lives in hiding in Nefia, using his body as a shield to protect his Little Sister, who is hunted by those who seek his power. He has no mercy for those who threaten his little angels.
en_grezzo: "He lives in hiding in Nefia, using his body as a shield to protect his Little Sister, who is hunted by those who seek his power. He has no mercy for those who threaten his little angels."
it: Vive nascosto nelle Nefia, e fa del proprio corpo uno scudo per proteggere la <Little Sister>, che chi cerca il potere insegue senza tregua. Con chi minaccia il suo piccolo angelo non usa nessuna pietà.

jp: 体内に溜め込んでいるエネルギーを多くの勢力から狙われている。そのため共生関係にあるビッグダディに護られながらネフィアに身を隠している。
jp_grezzo: "体内に溜め込んでいるエネルギーを多くの勢力から狙われている。そのため共生関係にあるビッグダディに護られながらネフィアに身を隠している。"
en: The energy he stores in his body is targeted by many forces. For this reason, she hides out in Nefia, protected by Big Daddy, with whom she has a symbiotic relationship.
en_grezzo: "The energy he stores in his body is targeted by many forces. For this reason, she hides out in Nefia, protected by Big Daddy, with whom she has a symbiotic relationship."
it: L'energia che tiene accumulata in corpo è nel mirino di molte fazioni. Per questo se ne sta nascosta nelle Nefia, protetta dal <Big Daddy>, con cui vive in simbiosi.

jp: リトルシスターの保護に一生を捧げる女科学者。何を思って保護しようとしているのか、彼女の過去に何があったのか、一体何を研究しているのか、すべては謎。
jp_grezzo: "リトルシスターの保護に一生を捧げる女科学者。何を思って保護しようとしているのか、彼女の過去に何があったのか、一体何を研究しているのか、すべては謎。"
en: A female scientist who devotes her life to protecting Little Sisters. What she is trying to protect, what happened in her past and what on earth she is researching are all mysteries.
en_grezzo: "A female scientist who devotes her life to protecting Little Sisters. What she is trying to protect, what happened in her past and what on earth she is researching are all mysteries."
it: Una donna di scienza che dedica tutta la vita a proteggere le <Little Sister>. Con che cosa in testa le protegga, che cosa ci sia stato nel suo passato, che cosa diamine stia studiando: tutto è un mistero.

jp: イルヴァを熱狂させる偶像をプロデュースしようと、その候補生達を集める為に旅する謎の男。魅力的な人物を見ると、男女構わずつい手を出してしまう悪い癖がある。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァを熱狂させる偶像をプロデュースしようと、その候補生達を集める為に旅する謎の男。魅力的な人物を見ると、男女構わずつい手を出してしまう悪い癖がある。"
en: A mysterious man who travels to gather candidates to produce an idol that will make Irva go crazy. When he sees an attractive person, he has a bad habit of making a move on them, regardless of gender.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious man who travels to gather candidates to produce an idol that will make Irva go crazy. When he sees an attractive person, he has a bad habit of making a move on them, regardless of gender."
it: Un uomo misterioso che gira il mondo per raccogliere le candidate con cui produrre l'idolo che manderà in delirio Irva. Quando vede una persona attraente ha il brutto vizio di allungare le mani, uomo o donna che sia.

jp: なんらかの生物の影が自意識に目覚め、元の生物を飲み込んだもの。古くは妖精のいたずらで姿を変質させられたものと信じられていた。
jp_grezzo: "なんらかの生物の影が自意識に目覚め、元の生物を飲み込んだもの。古くは妖精のいたずらで姿を変質させられたものと信じられていた。"
en: A shadow of some creature that has awakened to its own consciousness and swallowed the original creature. In ancient times, it was believed to have been transformed by a fairy's mischief.
en_grezzo: "A shadow of some creature that has awakened to its own consciousness and swallowed the original creature. In ancient times, it was believed to have been transformed by a fairy's mischief."
it: L'ombra di un essere vivente qualunque che si è destata a una coscienza propria e ha inghiottito l'essere da cui veniva. Un tempo si credeva che a cambiarle forma fosse stato il dispetto di una fata.

jp: 人気の無い場所に、ひっそりと暮らしている小人の一種。非常にすばしっこいがとても脆弱。その肉を食せば、食べた者も素早くなれるため、乱獲が懸念されている。
jp_grezzo: "人気の無い場所に、ひっそりと暮らしている小人の一種。非常にすばしっこいがとても脆弱。その肉を食せば、食べた者も素早くなれるため、乱獲が懸念されている。"
en: A type of gnome that lives in seclusion in unpopular places. They are very quick but very vulnerable. Overhunting is a concern, as their flesh can make the people who eat them very fast.
en_grezzo: "A type of gnome that lives in seclusion in unpopular places. They are very quick but very vulnerable. Overhunting is a concern, as their flesh can make the people who eat them very fast."
it: Una specie di piccolo essere che vive ritirato nei posti dove non passa nessuno. È svelto da non credere, ma anche fragilissimo. La sua carne rende svelto anche chi la mangia, e si teme che lo si cacci troppo.

jp: 滅亡の危機に陥っている同胞を守るため、弓を取り立ち向かう勇敢なクイックリング。異常な速さでの矢霰に、粉々にされる者も少なくない。
jp_grezzo: "滅亡の危機に陥っている同胞を守るため、弓を取り立ち向かう勇敢なクイックリング。異常な速さでの矢霰に、粉々にされる者も少なくない。"
en: Brave quicklings who take up their bows and stand up to defend their countrymen who are in danger of extinction. Many are shattered by their unusually fast hail of arrows.
en_grezzo: "Brave quicklings who take up their bows and stand up to defend their countrymen who are in danger of extinction. Many are shattered by their unusually fast hail of arrows."
it: Un quickling coraggioso, che ha preso l'arco e affronta il nemico per difendere i suoi, ormai sull'orlo dell'estinzione. Sono in tanti a finire ridotti in pezzi da quella grandinata di frecce di una rapidità anomala.

jp: 異常な素早さで彷徨する鐘の魔物。白金色のものは体がプラチナでできており、プラチナ硬貨を仲間と間違えて保護しようとする習性がある。
jp_grezzo: "異常な素早さで彷徨する鐘の魔物。白金色のものは体がプラチナでできており、プラチナ硬貨を仲間と間違えて保護しようとする習性がある。"
en: The platinum-coloured ones have bodies made of platinum and have a habit of mistaking platinum coins for their friends and trying to protect them.
en_grezzo: "The platinum-coloured ones have bodies made of platinum and have a habit of mistaking platinum coins for their friends and trying to protect them."
it: Un mostro campana che vaga con una rapidità anomala. Quelle color platino hanno il corpo fatto di platino, e hanno l'abitudine di scambiare le monete di platino per compagne e di provare a proteggerle.

jp: 異常な素早さで彷徨する鐘の魔物。黄金色のものはお金が大好き。自分の財産を守るためにあっという間に消え去ってしまう。
jp_grezzo: "異常な素早さで彷徨する鐘の魔物。黄金色のものはお金が大好き。自分の財産を守るためにあっという間に消え去ってしまう。"
en: A bell monster that wanders with abnormal speed. The golden ones love money. They disappear in the blink of an eye to protect their wealth.
en_grezzo: "A bell monster that wanders with abnormal speed. The golden ones love money. They disappear in the blink of an eye to protect their wealth."
it: Un mostro campana che vaga con una rapidità anomala. Quelle color oro vanno matte per il denaro. Per difendere il proprio patrimonio spariscono in un batter d'occhio.

jp: 井戸に潜みライフライン方面から侵略を行う異星生物。酸性の体液を持つ。さらなる高位の侵略者の尖兵に過ぎないという学説が近年の観測データから有力視されている。
jp_grezzo: "井戸に潜みライフライン方面から侵略を行う異星生物。酸性の体液を持つ。さらなる高位の侵略者の尖兵に過ぎないという学説が近年の観測データから有力視されている。"
en: An alien organism that lurks in wells and invades from the lifeline direction. Has acidic body fluids. The theory that they are merely sentinels of a higher invader is supported by recent observation data.
en_grezzo: "An alien organism that lurks in wells and invades from the lifeline direction. Has acidic body fluids. The theory that they are merely sentinels of a higher invader is supported by recent observation data."
it: Un essere di un altro pianeta, che si annida nei pozzi e invade passando per le condutture. Ha liquidi corporei acidi. La teoria che sia soltanto l'avanguardia di un invasore ben più alto è, per i dati raccolti di recente, la più accreditata.
